title: Capsaicin
description: Capsaicin is a sleek, performance-first modpack for Minecraft 1.21.5 that seamlessly blends cutting-edge optimizations, eye-catching visuals and intuitive quality-of-life enhancements.
body:
Overview  
--------  
Capsaicin is a carefully curated Fabric modpack for Minecraft 1.21.5 that delivers rock-solid performance, stunning visuals and smart quality-of-life improvements. Whether you’re exploring massive biomes, running a busy server, or simply chasing maximum FPS in vanilla, Capsaicin gives you the tools to customize every aspect of your experience—no compromise between speed, eye candy or convenience.  

Key Features 
------------  

### Performance Optimizations  
**Sodium + Sodium Extra:** Low-level rendering rewrite for huge FPS gains  
**Lithium:** Server-side logic optimizations to reduce lag spikes  
**FerriteCore:** Memory defragmentation for lower RAM usage  
**C2ME:** Concurrent chunk & entity processing for smoother multicore performance  
**Entity Culling & MoreCulling:** Skip rendering of off-screen or occluded entities  
**Dynamic FPS:** Automatically throttle framerate in low-action scenes  
**Fast IP Ping:** Preemptively measure server latency for faster joins  

### Visual Enhancements  
**Iris:** Full shader support on Fabric  
**Blur:** Subtle UI & background blur effects  
**Falling Leaves:** Animates drifting leaves in forests  
**ModelFix:** Corrects broken block & item models  
**Zoomify:** Smooth, adjustable zoom for scouting or screenshots  

### UI & Quality-of-Life Improvements  
**RoughlyEnoughItems (REI):** In-game recipe & item lookup  
**Jade:** On-screen entity & block tooltips  
**Searchables:** Searchable inventories, chests & containers  
**Mouse Tweaks:** Intuitive click-and-drag item movement  
**Clumps:** Merge XP orbs to reduce entity count  
**Controlling & Controlify:** Advanced key-bind visualization & remapping  
**ShulkerBoxTooltip:** Preview contents of shulker boxes in your inventory  

### Immersion & Social  
**VoiceChat:** Proximity voice chat for Fabric servers  
**Chat Heads:** Floating avatars above players’ heads  
**Capes:** Custom wearable capes  
**PresenceFootsteps:** Dynamic footstep sounds by surface  
**JourneyMap:** Real-time minimap & world mapper
